test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

His mother accompanies him wherever he goes.

options.text: He has accompanied his mother wherever she has gone.
He was accompanied by his mother wherever he went.
He is accompanied by his mother wherever he goes.
He accompanies his mother wherever she goes.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice, and we need to convert it to the passive voice.
 
• In the passive voice, the subject of the sentence is acted upon by the verb.
 
• The structure for converting a present simple tense sentence from active to passive voice is:

 **Subject + is/am/are + past participle + by + agent**.
 
• In the given sentence, "His mother" is the subject, "accompanies" is the verb, and "him" is the object.
 
• When converting to** passive voice**, "him" becomes the subject, "is accompanied" is the verb form, and "by his mother" is the agent.

Hence, the correct passive form is : **'*He is accompanied by his mother wherever he goes*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Passive voice is often used when the focus is on the action or when the doer of the action is unknown or unimportant.
 
• It is also used to be more formal or polite.
 
• For example: ***The book was read by the entire class.***
